title: Saudi point-of-sale spending, Q3 2024 vs Q3 2023

attempts.text: Saudi Arabia's point-of-sale card spending (SAMA) experienced a significant increase in the first quarter of 2024 compared to the same quarter in the previous year. The average weekly POS value increased by 8.4% from SAR 11.77 bn in Q3 2023 to SAR 12.76 bn in Q3 2024. This increase is attributed to an increase in the average weekly transactions, which rose by 14.6% from 176.5 million to 202.4 million in Q3 2024. The rise in transactions is a result of an increase in the average weekly value of Miscellaneous Goods and Services, which increased by 18.6% from SAR 1,537 mn to SAR 1,857 mn in Q3 2024. Additionally, the increase in Public Utilities was 11.5%, from SAR 65 mn to SAR 112 mn. The increase in Electronic & Electric Devices was 10.3%, from SAR 213 mn to SAR 238 mn. The largest movers (by size of change) in the first quarter of 2024 were Miscellaneous Goods and Services, Other, Restaurants & Café, and Public Utilities, with the increase in Public Utilities being the largest, increasing by 18.6%.

final_text: Average weekly point-of-sale spending in Saudi Arabia was SAR 12.76 bn in Q3 2024, up 8.4% from SAR 11.77 bn in Q3 2023. Average weekly transactions were 202.4 million (up 14.6%), and the average ticket was SAR 63.1 (down 5.4%). The largest movements were: Miscellaneous Goods and Services increased by SAR 242 mn; Other increased by SAR 221 mn; Restaurants & Café increased by SAR 145 mn.
